exam.title: Cell Biology — Unit Test
exam.subject: Biology
exam.instructions: Each question carries 1 mark. Some questions have multiple correct answers — select all that apply.
exam.difficultyNote: Calibrated from 3 sample questions of the 2025 paper: recall-based with a few application items.

questions.question: Which of the following is the main site of ATP synthesis in a eukaryotic cell?
questions.explanation: Oxidative phosphorylation and most ATP generation occur on the inner mitochondrial membrane.
questions.learningObjective: Identify the primary organelle responsible for ATP synthesis.

questions.question: Ribosomes are composed of which of the following?
questions.explanation: Ribosomes are nucleoprotein complexes made of rRNA and proteins.

questions.question: Which organelle is responsible for the intracellular digestion of worn-out organelles and foreign material?
questions.explanation: Lysosomes contain hydrolytic enzymes that digest macromolecules, worn-out organelles, and engulfed material.
questions.learningObjective: Connect lysosomal enzymes with intracellular digestion.

questions.question: The semifluid matrix filling the space between the nuclear envelope and the cell membrane is called the:
questions.explanation: Cytoplasm is the semifluid material between the nuclear envelope and plasma membrane; cytosol is its soluble component.
questions.learningObjective: Differentiate cytoplasm from cytosol and nucleoplasm.

questions.question: Which of the following cell organelles is bounded by a single membrane?
questions.explanation: Lysosomes are single-membrane-bound; mitochondria, plastids, and the nucleus are bounded by double membranes.

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the cell wall is correct?
options: It is present in animal cells and made of cholesterol
It is found in plant cells and provides structural support
It regulates the movement of all molecules in and out of the cell
It is a selectively permeable membrane made of phospholipids
questions.explanation: Plant cell walls provide rigidity and structural support and are distinct from the selectively permeable plasma membrane.
questions.learningObjective: Distinguish the cell wall from the plasma membrane.

questions.question: A student observes a cell with a prominent nucleus, a large central vacuole, and a cell wall. The cell is most likely a:
questions.explanation: A cell wall and large central vacuole are characteristic of mature plant cells.
questions.learningObjective: Infer cell type from observed structures.

questions.question: The structural organisation of the nucleus includes the nuclear envelope, nucleoplasm, nucleolus, and:
questions.explanation: The nucleus comprises the nuclear envelope, nucleoplasm, nucleolus, and chromatin.
questions.learningObjective: Recall the structural components of the nucleus.

questions.question: Which of the following are part of the endomembrane system?
questions.explanation: The endomembrane system includes the ER, Golgi apparatus, lysosomes, and vacuoles; mitochondria are excluded.
questions.learningObjective: Classify organelles that participate in the endomembrane system.
